dj_story_text: November twenty-fourth, nineteen seventy-six. Chicago's 'If You Leave Me Now' was number one in Britain. Official Charts confirms three consecutive weeks at the top. That tender, soaring ballad became the American band's only UK chart-topper, and a signature sound of seventies radio.
source_discrepancy: TDIM says the three-week run started Nov 24; Official Charts shows No.1 weeks Nov 13,20,27. Draft says number one on Nov 24 without repeating start claim.
